what: Seed variance for the in-dataset headline metrics, plus the cross-dataset breach AUC of the same checkpoints, over 4 seeds (42/43/44/45).
caveat: NOT a clean 5-seed replication of Task 8a. Seed 42 (xfer_w30) trained 15 epochs; seeds 43/44/45 trained 5. All four select the best checkpoint on the same `combined` criterion, so each is a valid run of the recipe, but the training budget is not held constant and a 5th seed is missing. Reported because it is measured, and because the in-dataset-vs-cross-dataset variance contrast below does not depend on the budget difference.
not_computed: transition-window macro-F1 and onset PR-AUC per seed -- each needs a separate eval pass per checkpoint; left blank rather than guessed.
finding: In-dataset metrics are stable across seeds and cross-dataset metrics are not. macro-F1 0.8337 +/- 0.0085, onset AUC k5 0.8968 +/- 0.0068, but DAPT breach AUC 0.808 +/- 0.0561 -- a standard deviation 8.2x larger than the onset AUC's. Every headline in-dataset number is safe to quote as a point value; no single-run cross-dataset number is.
